title: macOS remembered login and desktop preferences
description: Start a packaged test app with profile temp/desktop-preferences/profile, CDP 9493 and main inspector 9494. Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_TOKEN for an existing gateway. Uses real input, native window lifecycle, encrypted file checks and a replacement app copy. Does not alter gateway state or the operator profile.

preferences.intent: Remembered credentials survive app replacement with route, bounds and shortcut. Session-only credentials survive reload but not quit. Shared desktop login uses the same Remember me preference.
